searches.note: Eighteen searches of twenty eight, ten unspent. Most searches blocked the author's own sources (the houses' domains, Wine with Seth, Wikipedia) so the second source would be independent; one was held to wosa.co.za, dewetshof.com and wine.co.za, one to decanter.com and wine.co.za. No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: founding, people and dates, grapes, sites, making, label words, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
Where a search contradicted the record it was set right with its source; where a detail stood in one secondary source or none it was cut or hedged as the house's account.
